objective: Implement and independently check the TypeSafe advisory layer against #138–142
finish: All scoped implementation criteria verified; live delivery proof remains separately required

criteria.anchor: AC-ADAPTER-1: Bounded client rejects invalid/missing/oversized/sensitive inputs and unsafe responses, retains exact model/input identity and explicit unavailable/replay/interrupted records without exposing credentials.

AC-DUO-1: Both existing host directions retain goal, snapshot, independent peer, ownership, findings, budgets and gates. Off/shadow/advisory behaviour, privacy filtering, dispositions, failure suppression and resume are implemented and tested.

AC-EVAL-1: Corpus labels are independently checked before held-out execution; 50 evidence and 20 repair cases have family-separated splits and adequate label rationales. Private evaluation reports preserve denominators, uncertainty, versions, replay and honest baseline limits.
AC-DOCS-1: PRD and usage explain actual behaviour, planned/live/simulated boundaries, invocation and limitations without claiming unmeasured superiority.
GATE-TESTS: Full suite and focused changed-client checks pass with actual raw output.
